 Australian Dollar Outlook: AUD/USD Bears Eye March Low as US CPI Looms
 From stonex.com 
Friday's stronger-than-expected US payrolls report saw 165k jobs added versus 65k expected, while unemployment fell to 4.1%. This sent December Fed hike expectations back towards 80% and gave the US dollar a sizeable boost. Inflation pressures also appear to be building. Headline CPI has risen to 3.72% y/y, while producer prices have accelerated to 6.35%. And with one-year consumer inflation expectations elevated at 3.9%, the Fed has plenty of reasons to remain concerned about persistent inflation.
